reuse.why: It turns the three copied avg-action queries into one getMonthWideCategories helper and has the existing getBudgetData use the same condition fragment. The income/tracking check stays inline at each action as before.

duplication.why: It removes three verbatim copies of the category query and the separate hidden check in copyPreviousMonth, so the skip rule now exists once.

placement.why: The rule sits in actions.ts beside the month-wide actions and their data accessors, as SQL conditions applied where categories are selected.

scope.why: The change is limited to the month-wide category selection, its tests and a release note, and single-category actions are untouched.

maintainability.why: There is a single named definition of which categories month-wide actions touch. The fragment relies on the c/g aliases (documented in a comment), and getBudgetData's generic name now hides that it filters for month-wide use.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All month-wide actions (setZero, copyPreviousMonth, set3/6/12MonthAvg) select categories through MONTH_WIDE_CATEGORY_CONDITIONS.

disguised_duplication.where: None. The pre-existing duplicates are removed rather than reshaped.

one_place.where: MONTH_WIDE_CATEGORY_CONDITIONS in packages/loot-core/src/server/budget/actions.ts, used by getMonthWideCategories (setZero and the averages) and by getBudgetData (copyPreviousMonth).
